---
title: "留言板"
---

歡迎留下您的足跡！✍️

```{=html}
<style>
  .gb-form-card {
    background: #faf5ee;
    border: 1px solid #e8ddd0;
    border-radius: 12px;
    padding: 24px 28px;
    margin-bottom: 32px;
  }

  .gb-form-card label {
    display: block;
    font-weight: 600;
    margin-bottom: 6px;
    color: #6B4F4F;
  }

  .gb-form-card input[type="text"],
  .gb-form-card textarea {
    width: 100%;
    padding: 10px 14px;
    border: 1px solid #d3c5b8;
    border-radius: 8px;
    font-size: 15px;
    font-family: inherit;
    background: #fff;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
    transition: border-color 0.2s;
  }

  .gb-form-card input[type="text"]:focus,
  .gb-form-card textarea:focus {
    outline: none;
    border-color: #6B4F4F;
  }

  .gb-form-card textarea {
    height: 100px;
    resize: vertical;
  }

  .gb-submit-btn {
    background: #6B4F4F;
    color: #fff;
    border: none;
    border-radius: 8px;
    padding: 10px 28px;
    font-size: 15px;
    cursor: pointer;
    transition: background 0.2s;
  }

  .gb-submit-btn:hover {
    background: #4e3535;
  }

  .gb-notice {
    color: #c0392b;
    font-size: 13px;
    margin-top: -12px;
    margin-bottom: 12px;
    display: none;
  }

  .gb-messages {
    margin-top: 16px;
  }

  .gb-message-item {
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #e8ddd0;
    border-radius: 10px;
    padding: 16px 20px;
    margin-bottom: 14px;
    position: relative;
  }

  .gb-message-header {
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    gap: 10px;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
  }

  .gb-avatar {
    width: 36px;
    height: 36px;
    background: #6B4F4F;
    color: #fff;
    border-radius: 50%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    font-weight: bold;
    font-size: 15px;
    flex-shrink: 0;
  }

  .gb-name {
    font-weight: 600;
    color: #6B4F4F;
  }

  .gb-time {
    font-size: 12px;
    color: #aaa;
  }

  .gb-content {
    color: #333;
    line-height: 1.65;
    white-space: pre-wrap;
    word-break: break-word;
  }

  .gb-delete-btn {
    position: absolute;
    top: 12px;
    right: 14px;
    background: none;
    border: none;
    color: #ccc;
    font-size: 16px;
    cursor: pointer;
    line-height: 1;
    transition: color 0.2s;
  }

  .gb-delete-btn:hover {
    color: #c0392b;
  }

  .gb-empty {
    text-align: center;
    color: #bbb;
    padding: 32px 0;
    font-size: 15px;
  }
</style>

<!-- 留言表單 -->
<div class="gb-form-card">
  <label for="gb-name">姓名</label>
  <input type="text" id="gb-name" placeholder="請輸入您的姓名" maxlength="30">
  <div class="gb-notice" id="gb-name-notice">請填寫姓名</div>

  <label for="gb-content">留言內容</label>
  <textarea id="gb-content" placeholder="請輸入留言內容…" maxlength="500"></textarea>
  <div class="gb-notice" id="gb-content-notice">請填寫留言內容</div>

  <button class="gb-submit-btn" onclick="submitMessage()">送出留言</button>
</div>

<!-- 留言列表 -->
<div class="gb-messages" id="gb-messages"></div>

<script>
  const STORAGE_KEY = 'guestbook_messages';

  function getMessages() {
    try {
      return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(STORAGE_KEY)) || [];
    } catch {
      return [];
    }
  }

  function saveMessages(msgs) {
    localStorage.setItem(STORAGE_KEY, JSON.stringify(msgs));
  }

  function formatTime(isoStr) {
    const d = new Date(isoStr);
    const pad = n => String(n).padStart(2, '0');
    return `${d.getFullYear()}/${pad(d.getMonth()+1)}/${pad(d.getDate())} ${pad(d.getHours())}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`;
  }

  function avatarLetter(name) {
    return name.trim().charAt(0).toUpperCase() || '?';
  }

  function renderMessages() {
    const container = document.getElementById('gb-messages');
    const msgs = getMessages();

    if (msgs.length === 0) {
      container.innerHTML = '<div class="gb-empty">目前還沒有留言，快來第一個留言吧！</div>';
      return;
    }

    container.innerHTML = msgs.slice().reverse().map((m, i) => {
      const realIndex = msgs.length - 1 - i;
      return `
        <div class="gb-message-item">
          <button class="gb-delete-btn" onclick="deleteMessage(${realIndex})" title="刪除此留言">×</button>
          <div class="gb-message-header">
            <div class="gb-avatar">${avatarLetter(m.name)}</div>
            <div>
              <div class="gb-name">${escapeHtml(m.name)}</div>
              <div class="gb-time">${formatTime(m.time)}</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div class="gb-content">${escapeHtml(m.content)}</div>
        </div>
      `;
    }).join('');
  }

  function escapeHtml(str) {
    return str.replace(/&/g,'&amp;').replace(/</g,'&lt;').replace(/>/g,'&gt;').replace(/"/g,'&quot;');
  }

  function submitMessage() {
    const nameEl = document.getElementById('gb-name');
    const contentEl = document.getElementById('gb-content');
    const nameNotice = document.getElementById('gb-name-notice');
    const contentNotice = document.getElementById('gb-content-notice');

    const name = nameEl.value.trim();
    const content = contentEl.value.trim();

    let valid = true;
    if (!name) { nameNotice.style.display = 'block'; valid = false; }
    else { nameNotice.style.display = 'none'; }
    if (!content) { contentNotice.style.display = 'block'; valid = false; }
    else { contentNotice.style.display = 'none'; }
    if (!valid) return;

    const msgs = getMessages();
    msgs.push({ name, content, time: new Date().toISOString() });
    saveMessages(msgs);

    nameEl.value = '';
    contentEl.value = '';
    renderMessages();
  }

  function deleteMessage(index) {
    if (!confirm('確定要刪除這則留言嗎？')) return;
    const msgs = getMessages();
    msgs.splice(index, 1);
    saveMessages(msgs);
    renderMessages();
  }

  // 初始化
  renderMessages();
</script>
```
